section: Tall units H. 222 | for base unit H. 84
family: Tall H.222 | for base unit H.84
source_pages: printed p.146-150 / PDF 148-152 (the straight positions; the corner tall units are not held)
family_naming_note: A FAMILY OF ITS OWN, NAMESPACED, and the reason is the plinth. The catalog prints these units with the SAME letters as the plain H.222 chapter and a lower front of 84 / 81, so that the recess lands at the worktop of a base H.84 run - which stands on a 60 plinth, where family 'Tall H.222' stands on 100. A tall unit that joined that family would put its lower front 40 above the base run beside it. So this file declares its own height and plinth, and the section keeps the catalog's words.
door_versions_note: No data.door_versions, as tall_h210_base78.json and for the same reason: the split is recorded per type in gola_stack_top_to_bottom, which is exact and cannot leak.
extraction_note: 2026-09-28, for the 7612 perimeter on H.84 (Andriy): every straight position of the section read from pdftotext and the elevations checked on a 110-dpi render of the first page - 30 codes in 12 types. EVERY STACK SUMS TO 2220 in both executions, fronts, 30 mm zones and the 600 oven opening together - the invariant tall_h210_base78.json measured, holding here too. NOT HELD: the corner tall units and the corner tall units for oven (D/S, carcass W.90 / W.120 with a 70/75/85 panel) - no front_layout kind draws a tall corner yet.

data.plinth_note: 60, as base_h84.json: the lower front is 84 / 81 and must meet the H.84 run's worktop.

front_layout.split_note: SPLIT 2026-09-28 (Andriy: 'the upper door is drawn' - the rule C92640 at H.234 got on 2026-08-27, carried to every remainder column). The page prints the SUM and calls the top door custom-sized. The openings are the ESTABLISHED ones: 600 for an oven H.60 (claude/findings-2026-08-25-tall-h210-appliance-columns.md 1), a second 600 for the microwave/double oven as C92640's render showed - HERE BY ANALOGY, NOT RE-READ on this page (learned rule 4) - and 460 for an oven H.46. The door is DERIVED: remainder minus openings, the same number in both executions. The real door height is set by the appliance at order time (7612: Thermador MEDMC301WS wants a 1248 flush opening in CK7744, i.e. a 492 door).
